goal: Simplify the Pesaje card UX: clicking the card opens the detail dialog (which becomes the single place to configure params + run/re-run/iterate); remove the redundant 'Marcar como listo' button (close via the status badge) and the oversized 'Configurar parametros' button.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WeightingCountryCard renders neither a 'Marcar como listo' button nor a 'Configurar parametros' button.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: render the card in completed/open state; assert queryByText(/Marcar como listo/i) and /Configurar par/i are both null.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Clicking the card body opens the WeightingDetailModal; clicking the status badge or History icon does NOT open it (stopPropagation).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: click the card container -> dialog role visible; click the badge -> dialog still closed. Playwright: click a country card on /pesaje -> 'Detalle Pesaje' dialog appears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The detail dialog shows editable parameters and a run button labeled 'Ejecutar' when there is no prior run, and 'Re-ejecutar' when the latest run is completed or failed.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: open modal with run=null -> button text 'Ejecutar' + editable inputs present; open with a completed run -> button text 'Re-ejecutar'.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Launching from the dialog (Ejecutar/Re-ejecutar, after the confirm) calls createRun then executeRun with the params currently shown in the editor.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: edit a numeric param, click run, confirm; assert the create mutation was called with the edited parameters.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: When the process is closed (isClosed), the dialog params are read-only and no run button is shown; the WeightingHistoryModal's read-only detail view is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: render card with process closed -> open modal -> inputs absent/read-only, no 'Ejecutar' button. History modal still renders detail without a run button.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: WeightingConfigDialog component and its test are removed with no dangling imports; DEFAULT_WEIGHTING_PARAMS/WeightingParams imported from weightingParams.ts.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: grep: no references to WeightingConfigDialog remain; npx tsc -b passes.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: VERIFY_CMD is green and a Playwright smoke walkthrough of /pesaje (open card -> dialog -> close) passes.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b; then Playwright MCP click-through on running dev:e2e + mock.

tasks.desc: Update WeightingDetailModal: render even when run is null (first-run config state); add optional countryCode/period props; generalize editable params to a single canRun gate seeded from run.parameters_json or DEFAULT_WEIGHTING_PARAMS; unify footer run button as onRun(params) with dynamic 'Ejecutar'/'Re-ejecutar' label + confirm. Keep read-only when onRun is undefined.

Update WeightingCountryCard: make the Card clickable to open the modal (role/tabIndex/keyboard, stopPropagation on badge + history); remove 'Configurar parametros', 'Marcar como listo' (and handleMarkReady/canMarkReady), on-card 'Ejecutar' and 'Ver detalle'; unify handleExecutar/handleRerun into onRun; pass countryCode/period + onRun (undefined when closed) to the modal; import params from weightingParams.ts.
Delete WeightingConfigDialog.tsx and its test file; update WeightingCountryCard.test.tsx to the new behavior (no config/mark-ready/ejecutar-on-card; card click opens modal; run from modal).
Run VERIFY_CMD (npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b) and a Playwright smoke walkthrough of /pesaje.
